#squats #squat 
🏋️‍♂️ 5 Critical Squat Mistakes to Avoid for Perfect Form

Are you squatting the right way? 🤔
Many people make small mistakes during squats that lead to poor results, recurring pain, or even injuries. In this video, I’ll show you how to perform the perfect squat technique and avoid the most common errors that can hold you back.

Squats are one of the best exercises to build strong legs, glutes, and core stability — but only if done correctly. By improving your form, you’ll lift heavier, stay injury-free, and see faster progress in strength and mobility.

🔑 What You’ll Learn in This Video:

✅ How to keep your upper back tight for stability
✅ The right way to brace your spine and core during heavy lifts
✅ How to master the squat descent with proper control
✅ Fixing the “good morning squat” mistake to protect your lower back
✅ Finding your optimal squat stance for maximum comfort & power

Whether you’re a beginner learning squats at home or an experienced lifter hitting a plateau, these tips will help you squat with confidence, safety, and power.

⚡ Benefits of Correct Squat Technique:

Builds strong legs & glutes 🦵
Improves posture & athletic performance
Protects joints & spine from unnecessary strain
Increases overall strength & mobility

📌 Medical Disclaimer:

This video is for educational and informational purposes only. Always consult with a certified trainer, physical therapist, or healthcare professional before starting a new workout routine, especially if you have existing injuries or medical conditions.
